Excellent Vietnamese dinner
Aug 2026 • Couples
We went to Cái Mâm after returning to Hanoi and were looking for a restaurant in the Old Quarter where we could try Vietnamese cuisine without ending up in the classic, overly touristy spot.

The atmosphere is very pleasant and well-kept, informal but with nice attention to both the service and the presentation of the dishes.

We tried several dishes to share, including fried spring rolls, morning glory sautéed with garlic, a Vietnamese salad with vegetables and peanuts, and an excellent dish with rice vermicelli, fresh herbs, peanuts, and meat rolls wrapped in leaves.

Everything we tasted was very good, with generous portions and, above all, many different flavors. It is exactly the type of Vietnamese cuisine we were looking for: traditional, but served in a more comfortable and well-kept environment compared to street food.

The service was also attentive and friendly, and the location, in the heart of the Old Quarter, is very convenient for continuing the evening by walking around the neighborhood.

One of our great gastronomic discoveries in Hanoi and a restaurant that I would definitely recommend.

Authentic Tasty Food
Jun 2026 • Family
If you are looking for an authentic, flavor-packed dining experience in Hanoi, this place is an absolute must-visit. We’ve been traveling around Vietnam, and the meal we had here was hands-down one of the absolute best of our entire trip.
Every single dish we ordered hit the mark:
 The Beef Stir-Fry: The beef tenderloin was incredibly tender, perfectly cooked, and melted in your mouth.
 The Crispy Shrimp: Beautifully prepared with a flawless, satisfying crunch while keeping the shrimp perfectly juicy.
 The Beef Rice Noodles: A wonderful balance of fresh, vibrant flavors and perfect texture.
 The Veggie Dishes: This was the ultimate standout for us. We’ve tried a lot of food on this trip, but the vegetable dishes here were by far the best we’ve tasted. Fresh, crisp, and expertly seasoned.
The balance of fresh herbs, perfect textures, and deep flavors made this an unforgettable meal. Highly, highly recommended if you are in Hanoi!
